gloss: by a hair's breadth; in the nick of time

definitions.gloss: by a hair's breadth; in the nick of time; narrow escape
definitions.explanation: Describes a situation where something is avoided or achieved with an extremely slim margin. Often used for near-misses and last-second saves.

examples.japanese: {間一髪|かんいっぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{免|まぬが}れた→免れる：10548_manugareru⟧。
{間一髪|かんいっぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}った→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: I made it onto the train just in the nick of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧きた⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間一髪|かんいっぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{避|よ}けて→避ける：14848_yokeru⟧、⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}んだ→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I dodged the falling sign by a hair's breadth and escaped without injury.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧ (gap, interval) + {一髪|いっぱつ} (one hair). Literally "a gap of one hair," expressing an extremely narrow margin.

USAGE:
Often used adverbially in the pattern {間一髪|かんいっぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ or {間一髪|かんいっぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (at the last moment, by a narrow margin).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {間一髪|かんいっぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{助|たす}かる→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧ (to be saved by a hair's breadth)
- {間一髪|かんいっぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧ (to escape by the narrowest margin)
- {間一髪|かんいっぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (at the very last moment)
